title.zh: ECB opens merchant applications for controlled 2027 digital euro pilot
title.en: ECB opens merchant applications for controlled 2027 digital euro pilot

current_state.zh: The European Central Bank has opened applications for online merchants to join a controlled 2027 digital euro checkout pilot connecting them with 36 payment providers, while noting the beta is not legal tender and issuance still requires legislation and a separate ECB decision.
current_state.en: The European Central Bank has opened applications for online merchants to join a controlled 2027 digital euro checkout pilot connecting them with 36 payment providers, while noting the beta is not legal tender and issuance still requires legislation and a separate ECB decision.
